requested_primary_changes.requested_change: At the existing ingestion call sites, emit compact allowlisted start/complete/failure telemetry for load, process, vector, graph, resume/skip, and checkpoint boundaries. Include run_id, normalized tickers, as_of when present, dataset_version, VectorStoreConfig schema/adapter identity, embedding model/version/cache schema when instantiated, stage=03, stage_revision=1, attempt=1, agent=data_rag, monotonic latency_ms, document/chunk/quarantine/upsert or relation counts, stage status, and explicit degraded flags. Do not emit query text, article/chunk text, URLs, credentials, headers, provider payloads, or prompts. Add offline mock assertions for metadata allowlisting, latency presence, resume visibility, failure/degraded status, and non-emission of raw evidence/secrets.

requested_primary_changes.reason: StageStatus.error persists str(exc) in the checkpoint and rag.seed serializes it to CLI output. External/provider exception strings are not an allowlisted compact field and may contain credentials, private request content, URLs, raw payload fragments, or other sensitive data.
requested_primary_changes.requested_change: Persist and print only a deterministic sanitized error category/code suitable for operators; keep untrusted exception text out of IngestionManifest, checkpoint JSON, breadcrumbs, logs, and CLI output. Add an offline regression test using an exception message containing sentinel secret/raw-payload text and assert that no persisted or emitted artifact contains the sentinels.
